Audio Creation Studio

A mini DAW inside the Unity Editor for making game sound effects: build multitrack sounds, mix, add effects, synthesize procedurally, generate SFX with AI, make seamless loops, create variations and export, all without leaving Unity.

Unity 2022.3 LTS or newer Dependencies none (pure C# DSP) Export WAV · AIFF · FLAC · MP3 · OGG Non-destructive

Workflow

Import→Arrange→Trim→Mix→Process→Preview→Export

Open the tool from Tools ▸ Audio Creation Studio ▸ Open Studio (⌥⇧⌘A on Mac, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A on Windows), or double-click an Audio Recipe asset.

Seven workspaces

🎚️ Arrange

Multitrack timeline: real waveforms, trims, fades, automation lanes.

🎛️ Mixer

Channel strips: faders, pan, mute/solo, effect chains, live meters.

✨ AI Generate

Describe a sound in text and ElevenLabs creates it. Takes are organised in folders.

🔊 Custom Generate

Procedural synth with 11 presets; also accepts AI takes as a Sample source.

🔁 Loop

Seamless loops: crossfade, boundary analysis, ×1/×5/×10 preview.

🎲 Variations

Controlled random variants, A/B comparison, batch export.

📚 Library

Presets for generators, effects, effect chains, recipes and export settings.
ℹ

Non-destructive: every edit is stored in an Audio Recipe. Source AudioClips and their import settings are never changed, so you can reopen and edit a recipe at any time.

01Installation

The tool is distributed as a Unity package via Git.

Requirements

  • Unity 2022.3 or newer.
  • Git installed (Unity downloads the package with git). Check with git --version in a terminal.
    • macOS: if it is missing, the system offers to install the Command Line Tools; click Install.
    • Windows: download from git-scm.com, then restart Unity Hub.
  • Read access to SCVN-Brian/AudioCreationStudio if the repo is private (the machine must be able to git clone it).
  • Optional: ffmpeg (only for MP3/OGG export) and an ElevenLabs API key (only for AI sound generation).

Open Packages/manifest.json in your project and add this line to "dependencies":

"com.supercent.audiocreationstudio": "https://github.com/SCVN-Brian/AudioCreationStudio.git?path=Assets/AudioCreationStudio#v1.3.0"

Full example:

{
  "dependencies": {
    "com.supercent.audiocreationstudio": "https://github.com/SCVN-Brian/AudioCreationStudio.git?path=Assets/AudioCreationStudio#v1.3.0",
    "com.unity.modules.audio": "1.0.0"
  }
}

Switch back to Unity and wait for it to download and compile.

  1. Open Window ▸ Package Manager.
  2. Click + ▸ Add package from git URL…
  3. Paste this URL and click Add:
https://github.com/SCVN-Brian/AudioCreationStudio.git?path=Assets/AudioCreationStudio#v1.3.0
⚠

The ?path=Assets/AudioCreationStudio part is required, because the package lives in a subfolder of the repo. #v1.3.0 is the version tag; without it Unity takes the latest code on main, which is not recommended for real projects.

Updating

Change the tag at the end of the URL (for example #v1.3.0 → #v1.4.0) in manifest.json and switch back to Unity. If Unity keeps the old version, delete the com.supercent.audiocreationstudio entry in Packages/packages-lock.json and switch back to Unity again.

Uninstalling

Remove the com.supercent.audiocreationstudio line from Packages/manifest.json. Files in Assets/AudioCreationStudio/ (exports, presets…) stay; delete them by hand if you no longer need them.

02Settings (Preferences)

Open with Tools ▸ Audio Creation Studio ▸ Settings… or Preferences ▸ Audio Creation Studio.

🔒

All settings are stored in EditorPrefs on this computer. They are never written into the project or git, so your keys are not shared with anyone.

🔑 ElevenLabs API key

Needed for AI sound generation.

  1. Get a key at elevenlabs.io ▸ Developers ▸ API Keys.
  2. Paste it into API Key and click Save.
  3. Or set the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable.

Each take uses credits from your ElevenLabs plan.

🧠 Prompt writer (Gemini / OpenAI)

Needed for Analyze Sound (turns a description into parameters).

  1. Open aistudio.google.com/apikey, sign in with Google, click Create API key (free).
  2. Paste it under Prompt writer, or set GEMINI_API_KEY.
  3. You can switch to OpenAI instead (default gpt-4.1-mini).

🎞️ ffmpeg

Only needed to export MP3 / OGG.

  • macOS: brew install ffmpeg
  • Windows: winget install ffmpeg

Found automatically (PATH, Homebrew, WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey). Otherwise click Browse… and pick the ffmpeg binary.

03Your first SFX in 5 minutes

From existing audio files to a finished WAV.

  1. Open the studio. Tools ▸ Audio Creation Studio ▸ Open Studio. A new recipe opens with two empty tracks and a limiter on the master bus.
  2. Import. Drag AudioClips from the Project window onto a track. Dropping several clips below the last track stacks them as layers on new tracks. The toolbar's Import button adds the clips selected in the Project window, or lets you browse for a file (files from outside the project are copied into Assets/AudioCreationStudio/Imported).
  3. Arrange. Drag clips to move them, also across tracks. Snapping is on by default (magnet button); hold Ctrl to bypass it, or Alt-drag to duplicate.
  4. Trim. Hover a clip edge until the cursor changes, then drag. The audio stays anchored in time.
  5. Fade. Drag the round handles at the top corners of a clip; choose curves in the Inspector.
  6. Mix. Use each track header's gain slider, pan knob and M/S chips, or open the Mixer tab.
  7. Process. Select a track ▸ Add Effect in the Inspector (for example High-Pass, then Compressor). The order of the cards is the processing order.
  8. Preview. Press Space. Edits during playback are rendered in the background and playback continues with the new mix. Double-click a clip to hear it alone.
  9. Export. Click Export (top right), choose Full Mix, PCM 16-bit, a folder under Assets ▸ Export WAV. The file is imported automatically.
  10. Save. Click the save icon to store the recipe as an asset, so you can reopen and change it at any time.
💡

No audio yet? Right-click an empty lane ▸ Insert Generated ▸ Pickups ▸ Coin Pickup.

Where sounds are built: multiple tracks, clips with real waveforms, trims, fades and automation.

Snapping targets the timeline start, the playhead, loop region edges, other clip edges and the minor grid (8 px threshold). A dashed amber line shows the active snap.

Edit tools (DaVinci Resolve style)

The four tool buttons next to Split and Snap on the toolbar:

ToolKeyWhat dragging does
SelectionASelect, move, trim edges (leaves a gap), fades.
Trim EditT Body (waveform) → Slip: moves the audio inside the clip; the clip keeps its position and length. The whole source is drawn faintly behind it while you drag.
Name bar → Slide: moves the clip; touching neighbours get longer or shorter so no gap opens.
Edge → Ripple trim: changes the clip length, and every later clip on the track moves with it.
Cut between two touching clips (±3 px) → Roll: moves the cut; one clip gets longer, the other shorter.
BladeBClick to cut (snaps). Shift-click cuts every track. A yellow line previews the cut.
Dynamic TrimWSame gestures as Trim Edit, and the edited area plays back automatically (the whole clip for slip/slide, ±1 s around the cut for roll/ripple).

, / . nudge the selected clips by 10 ms (Shift: 100 ms). In Selection mode they move the clips; in Trim / Dynamic Trim they slip the audio. While dragging, a readout shows the size of the edit (e.g. Slip −100.0 ms · in 00:00.100). Each drag is a single undo step.

Automation

  1. Click the curve icon on a track header to show its automation lane.
  2. Pick the target from the dropdown: Track Gain, Track Pan or any effect parameter.
  3. Click the lane to add points; drag to move them (Shift = value only); Alt-click or double-click to delete.
  4. Right-click a point for Linear / Smooth / Step.

Clip gain and pan automation is edited in the clip Inspector. While a lane has points, automation overrides the static value.

05Mixer

One channel strip per track: fader, pan, mute/solo, effect chain and live meters.

  • Fader / Pan set the track's level and stereo position.
  • M / S mute or solo the track.
  • The effect list on a strip is in processing order; edit the details in the Effects rack.
  • The master bus has a Limiter by default to prevent clipping on export.

06AI Generate (ElevenLabs)

Generate real audio from a text description, then edit it with all of the studio's tools. The form is on the left and the Take Library on the right (drag the divider to resize, double-click it to reset to 50/50).

⚠

Requires an internet connection, an ElevenLabs API key and, for Analyze, a Gemini or OpenAI key. Each take uses credits; usage rights follow your ElevenLabs plan.

Step 1 · Describe the sound

Write a description in English or Vietnamese, then click Analyze Sound (or Analyze & Generate). The AI turns it into nine structured parameters, plus a short explanation and any warnings in your language.

Step 2 · Review the parameters

ParameterMeaning
Sound SourceWhat makes the sound (object, material)
Action / EventWhat happens to cause it
Sound TextureSonic character (comma-separated list)
PitchHow high or low it is
Rhythm / TimingPattern, repetitions, spacing
IntensityHow strong it is
StyleCartoon, realistic, …
Duration / StructureSeconds, attack, sustain, release
ConstraintsThings to avoid: music, ambience, dialogue, reverb…

The ▾ menus offer common values. Fields you change are marked in amber (the tooltip shows the AI's suggestion), and Reset to AI restores them. You can also fill the fields in yourself without AI.

Step 3 · The ElevenLabs prompt

An English prompt is built locally from the parameters and updates on every edit (max 300 characters; the least important parts are dropped first). You can still edit it by hand; parameter changes then stop overwriting it, and Rebuild from Parameters brings it back.

Generation options

OptionDescription
DurationAuto, or a fixed 0.5–30 s
Prompt InfluenceDefault 30%; higher follows the text more literally
Seamless LoopFor ambiences and engines
Modeleleven_text_to_sound_v2 (default) or _v3
Takes1–4 versions per click (each costs credits)
ReferenceDrop a clip in: Use matches its length and adds a timing hint to the prompt; A/B plays the reference, then a take

Click Generate with ElevenLabs. Takes are saved into the folder selected in the Take Library (under Assets/AudioCreationStudio/Generated/ElevenLabs/) with a .txt sidecar recording the prompt and settings. The first take plays automatically.

Buttons on each take: ▶ play · A/B · Edit in Custom (opens it in Custom Generate) · Insert (adds it on a new track at the playhead) · Loop (opens it in the Loop editor) · ⋯ (move, rename, show in Project, delete).

💡

Prompt tip: describe the sound itself, e.g. medium dog barking twice, close mic, dry. Avoid instructions ("make…") and onomatopoeia ("woof woof"); they are often read aloud as speech.

Take Library

A folder tree on the left and the selected folder's takes on the right. All Takes shows every take with a chip naming its folder.

  • New Folder creates a subfolder; double-click to rename; right-click for New Folder Inside / Rename / Show in Project / Delete.
  • Drag and drop takes onto a folder to move them; drag a folder onto another to nest it; drag AudioClips from the Project window to copy them in. Hovering a collapsed folder opens it.
  • Select several with Cmd/Ctrl-click or Shift-click; the selection bar offers Move to…, Insert and Delete.
  • Keys: ↑/↓ select, Space play, F2/Enter rename, Delete delete, ⌘/Ctrl+A select all, Esc clear.
  • Search filters by file name and prompt.
  • New takes go into the selected folder (the green "New takes →" pill shows where).
ℹ

Folders are real asset folders and moves go through the AssetDatabase, so clip GUIDs survive and clips already on the timeline keep working.

07Custom Generate

A procedural synth: presets on the left, visualizers in the middle, parameters on the right.

Signal flow

Oscillator / Noise+Sub-osc→Tremolo→Filter LP/HP/BP→Drive→ADSR→Volume
  • Oscillator: Sine, Square (with duty cycle), Triangle, Saw; or Noise (white, pink); or Sample (an AudioClip).
  • Pitch: start→end sweep (with curve), an instant jump (coin-style), vibrato, and noise FM (engine wobble).
  • ADSR: One-shot mode (no sustain hold), or sustain held until duration − release.
  • Deterministic: the same settings and seed always give the same sound. Randomize derives new settings, then advances the seed.

11 presets

Coin PickupUI ClickPopNotification WhooshImpactUpgradeCartoon Jump Machine StartMachine RunningMachine Stop

Actions

Preview (Space) · Generate · Randomize · Seed · Save Preset · Insert Into Timeline (creates a generator clip at the playhead; later edits update that clip and can be undone) · Export WAV.

Use existing audio as a Sample source

📥 Import Sound

The Import Sound button next to the sound's name: Browse for a File…, Use Selected in Project, or Recent AI Takes. You can also drag a file (wav, aiff, mp3, ogg, flac) or an AudioClip onto the tab.

✨ From an AI take

Click Edit in Custom on a take. It loads as Oscillator ▸ Sample with neutral settings, so it plays unchanged until you tweak it.

🎚️ From a timeline clip

Right-click a clip ▸ Edit in Custom Generate. The clip keeps its position, length, gain, pan, fades and loop; every change updates it live. Revert to Original Audio brings the plain file back.

With a Sample source, pitch transposes in semitones (varispeed: higher also plays faster), the ADSR shapes and shortens it, and filter/noise/tremolo/drive all apply. Start Offset skips into the sample and Fit Duration to Sample matches its length. Samples play mono; Frequency and Sub Osc don't apply.

08Loop · Seamless loops

For running machines, ambiences and short music beds.

  1. Choose a source: Mix (the rendered recipe), Clip (right-click a clip ▸ Open in Loop Editor) or Asset (any AudioClip).
  2. Drag the markers START (green) and END (red). With Zero Snap on, each marker jumps to the nearest zero crossing when released.
  3. Set the crossfade length and curve (Linear or Equal Power). Pre-roll mode keeps the loop length; Overlap mode (not enough audio before START) shortens the loop by the crossfade length.
  4. Compare the raw cut and crossfaded boundary views (±20 ms zoom).
  5. Read the Boundary Analysis: Jump (under 3× counts as seamless), Level match (RMS difference between the first and last 10 ms), Clicks (spikes detected on a 2× repeat).
  6. Listen with Loop ∞, ×1, ×5, ×10. Always confirm by ear: the metrics don't guarantee a loop sounds seamless.
  7. Export Loop WAV (written with a smpl chunk) or Use as Timeline Loop Region to copy the points to the recipe.
⚠

Unity ignores the smpl chunk, so enable Loop on the AudioSource. Because the exported file is exactly one loop, looping the whole clip in Unity is seamless. Wwise, FMOD and most DAWs read the chunk.

09Variations

Make repeated sounds (footsteps, shots, pickups) less fatiguing.

RangeEffect
Pitch ±Varispeed (duration scales; clip lengths are compensated so the same source region plays)
Volume ±Master gain offset
Start OffsetExtra offset into AudioClip sources
Timing ±Shifts clip starts (clips at 0 stay anchored so the attack is not delayed)
Layer DropProbability of muting each layer; at least one layer is always kept
Effect ParamsMoves continuous effect parameters by a fraction of their range

Actions: Generate · ▶ preview · A/B (original, then variant) · Play All in Sequence · 💾 save a variant as a new recipe · ⬆ export one · Batch Export WAVs (runs in the background with progress and Cancel).

ℹ

The same seed always gives the same set of variants, so results are reproducible.

10Library

Shared presets: generators, effects, effect chains, recipes and export settings.

  • Save an effect preset: on the effect card, ⋯ ▸ Save Preset.
  • Save a whole chain: the rack's ⋯ menu.
  • Save a generator preset: Save Preset in Custom Generate.
  • User presets live in Assets/AudioCreationStudio/UserPresets/; commit that folder if your team shares them.

11Effects rack

Nine pure-C# effects. Select a track ▸ Add Effect in the Inspector.

Every effect has: Enable (removes it from processing) · BYP (bypass, keeps the slot) · Reset · Presets (⋯ ▸ Save/Load) · ▲/▼ reorder (= processing order) · automation for every continuous parameter.

EffectParametersUse it for
GainGain dBLevel changes inside a chain
Low-PassCutoff, Resonance QDarker, distant, muffled sounds
High-PassCutoff, Resonance QRemoving rumble and excess bass
Parametric EQLow shelf, Mid 1 & 2 (freq, gain, Q), High shelfShaping tone
CompressorThreshold, Ratio, Attack, Release, Knee, Makeup, MixPunch and consistency
LimiterCeiling, Input Gain, ReleasePreventing clipping on the master (output ≤ ceiling guaranteed, zero latency)
DistortionMode (Soft/Hard/Fold), Drive, Tone, Mix, OutputGrit, machines, aggression
DelayTime, Feedback, Mix, Damping, Ping-PongEchoes and stereo width
ReverbRoom Size, Damping, Width, Pre-Delay, MixRoom and space

Effect tails (delay, reverb) are estimated automatically, up to 10 s; export can include or exclude them.

12Export

Click Export at the top right. Files go to Assets/AudioCreationStudio/Exports by default and are imported automatically.

FormatNeedsQualityNotes
WAVnothingPCM 16 / 24, Float 32The only format with loop metadata (smpl)
AIFFnothingPCM 16 / 24, Float 32
FLACnothingLossless 16 / 24Unity doesn't import .flac; use it for archiving or sharing
MP3ffmpeg64–320 kbps, max 48 kHzNot gapless (encoder padding), so avoid it for loops
OGGffmpeg64–320 kbps

Options

Scope

Full Mix · Selected Track (soloed through master) · Selected Clip (plus tail) · Loop Region

Processing

Sample rate · mono/stereo · include tails · normalize to a target peak (off by default) · trim silence with a threshold · TPDF dither for 16-bit

🛡️

Safe writes: each file is written to a temp file, its header is validated, then it is moved into place. Cancelling or an error never damages an existing file.

14Recipes & demos

Every sound you make is stored as an Audio Recipe: a ScriptableObject that describes how to build the sound, not a rendered audio file.

  • A recipe holds tracks, clips, effects, automation, generator settings, the loop region, export settings and variation settings.
  • Source clips are referenced by GUID, so renaming or moving files doesn't break a recipe.
  • A missing source plays silence and shows a red "Missing source" clip.
  • Create one with Create ▸ Audio Creation Studio ▸ Audio Recipe, or Save in the studio.

Four built-in demos

16Troubleshooting

Common problems and how to fix them.

"No 'git' executable was found"
Git is not installed, or Unity can't see it. Install Git, then restart Unity Hub and Unity.
Authentication error / "repository not found"
The machine has no read access to the private repo. Try git clone https://github.com/SCVN-Brian/AudioCreationStudio.git in a terminal; if that works, Unity can download it too.
"Could not find package.json"
The ?path=Assets/AudioCreationStudio part of the URL is missing or wrong.
No sound at all
Unity sometimes loses its output device (sleep, headphones/Bluetooth switching). Use ⚙ ▸ Reset Audio Output; if that doesn't help, restart Unity.
Playback stops when I press ▶ in the Inspector
The studio shares its preview channel with the AudioClip Inspector. Pressing ▶ there stops the studio; press Play again.
MP3/OGG/AIFF/FLAC sources can't be read
WAV is read directly. Other formats need Load Type = Decompress On Load in their import settings; the tool reports the problem instead of changing settings for you.
MP3/OGG export says ffmpeg is missing
Install ffmpeg (see Settings). On Mac, Unity launched from the Dock doesn't read the terminal's PATH, but the tool still checks /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin; otherwise click Browse….
Generate does nothing
Check the Console: without an API key the tool logs a warning saying where to set it. Paste the key in Preferences ▸ Audio Creation Studio.
The AI reads my prompt aloud as speech
Write the prompt in English and describe the sound itself. Avoid instructions ("make…") and onomatopoeia ("woof woof"). The panel warns before generating such prompts.
Unity keeps the old version after changing the tag
Delete the com.supercent.audiocreationstudio entry in Packages/packages-lock.json and switch back to Unity.
"Rebuild Demo Assets" fails
The package is read-only, so demos can't be overwritten. The existing demos still open normally.

17Limitations

The tool is built for short SFX, from a few seconds to about a minute.

  • Offline rendering: preview renders the whole mix, capped at 10 minutes.
  • Pitch variation is varispeed: pitch and duration change together; there is no time-stretching.
  • Generator voices are mono; stereo width comes from pan, ping-pong delay and reverb.
  • Distortion has no oversampling (aliasing is possible at extreme drive); the Limiter has no lookahead (to keep timeline alignment exact).
  • ElevenLabs accepts text only; a reference only influences the result through its duration and a text hint.
  • Verified platform: Unity 2022.3.19f1 on macOS. Windows/Linux and Unity 6 have not been fully tested.
